documents.title: Espresso basics
documents.text: Espresso tastes bitter when water stays in contact with the coffee too long.

documents.title: Grinder notes
documents.text: A finer grind slows the shot, and a slow shot can taste bitter.

queries.query: how do I fix bitter espresso

documents.title: Dialing in
documents.text: To fix bitter espresso, grind coarser and shorten the shot.
